messages:
Lina: quick thread 1: inbound from 3 customers asking for extended pin windows + clearer migration credits. want to sketch a short-term playbook we can ship next sprint.

Derek: can we define "short-term" precisely? what's the minimum-safe workflow we need to approve a pin without adding infra reservations?

Sam: minimum: approval form, a light smoke eval (20 prompts), and a comm template. no capacity reservations for now. mark pins as "best-effort" in console.

Cassie: CS note 1: we need an SLA statement to set expectations. propose: "pins are honored but not guaranteed under capacity pressure; migration windows will be provided". Also require customer signature on acceptance.

Derek: dev constraints: we can add a catalog flag + approval API in 1 sprint. smoke-eval runner is another half-sprint. storing snapshot in catalog metadata is cheap.

Lina: launch criteria proposal: (1) approval API + UI, (2) smoke-eval pipeline + snapshot, (3) comm/playbook template, (4) console label and billing tag. All must be green to flip feature flag.

Sam: bench threshold: pinned model must not regress >2% on NLU intent accuracy on the smoke set, and p95 latency <= baseline * 1.25. if failing, require mitigation plan before approval.

Cassie: comms: include migration-recommendation steps, expected timelines, and where to request migration credits. We'll use manual credits initially.

Derek: ops concern: add a dashboard tile for pinned-model tail-latency and fragmentation %. ops-bot can create alert if fragmentation >20%.

ops-bot: Created alert rule "pinned_fragmentation_high" threshold=20% notify=#eng-oncall.

Lina: action items: Derek scope tickets for approval API + catalog flag (EOD). Sam draft smoke-eval prompts and thresholds (tomorrow). Cassie draft customer acceptance + comms (tomorrow). I'll bundle into a one-pager for roadmap sync.

Derek: ack. aiming to land MVP by end of next sprint if nothing blocks.

Sam: will coordinate with QA on prompt selection.

Cassie: will prep a short consent template for legal review.

Lina: thanks all 1: ship conservative, iterate. we'll revisit capacity-reservations in Q3 if beta shows demand.
